{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv"
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Check for duplicate patient_id values
duplicate_patients = data['patient_id'].duplicated(keep=False)
duplicate_count = duplicate_patients.sum()

# Get the patient_ids that are duplicated
duplicated_ids = data.loc[duplicate_patients, 'patient_id'].unique()

# Show the number of duplicate patient_ids and sample_seq values
print(f"Number of patients with duplicate entries: {duplicate_count}")
print(f"Unique patient IDs with duplicates: {len(duplicated_ids)}")

# Check how many rows per patient_id
rows_per_patient = data.groupby('patient_id').size()
print(f"Max sample_seq per patient: {data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max().max()}")
print(f"Distribution of sample_seq per patient:\n{rows_per_patient.value_counts().sort_index()}")"}
